$comment: The DSH web shell's platform seed table — the complete set of module specifiers a client plugin bundle may require() at runtime. The shell hardcodes this table in its Vite bundle (search for `staticModules:` in dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-*.js); it is the ONLY module surface a plugin can reach. Anything outside it must arrive as a boot-graph package row, which a plugin cannot conjure. Regenerate with `npm run sync:platform -- <path-to-installed-dsh>` when targeting a new DSH release.
